definitions.explanation: A close-fitting cap, usually made of rubber or silicone, worn to protect hair while swimming and to reduce drag in the water.

examples.japanese: {水泳帽|すいえいぼう}を{被|かぶ}って{入水|にゅうすい}する。
examples.english: Put on a swim cap before entering the water.

examples.japanese: このプールでは{水泳帽|すいえいぼう}の{着用|ちゃくよう}が{義務|ぎむ}づけられている。
examples.english: Wearing a swimming cap is required at this pool.

examples.japanese: {競泳|きょうえい}では{水泳帽|すいえいぼう}と{水着|みずぎ}の{素材|そざい}が{記録|きろく}に{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}えることもある。
examples.english: In competitive swimming, the material of the swim cap and swimsuit can affect race times.

notes:
Required at most Japanese public pools and swimming clubs. Also referred to as スイミングキャップ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水泳帽|すいえいぼう}を{被|かぶ}る: to put on a swim cap
- {水泳帽|すいえいぼう}を{着用|ちゃくよう}する: to wear a swim cap (formal/official language)
- {競技用|きょうぎよう}{水泳帽|すいえいぼう}: competition swim cap
